drafted_from: tool:cut-and-caption's own row in tools/media-composition/tool-rows.json, tools/media-composition/do-work/cut-and-caption.mjs, and the script run on a synthetic 7 second clip
start_here: Say to your AI: "Cut seconds 3.5 to 6 out of my video and caption it with the words spoken there." It runs tool:cut-and-caption and saves the clip in your files.
no_lists_because: It makes a new video in your files from the video you name and keeps no list of its own.
instructions: 1. Find your video's identity and exact length in bytes in your files, and the start and end in seconds of the stretch to keep (tool:find-action-moments or tool:find-silence can name one).

2. Say "Cut this stretch and caption it" with files, from and to. Add transcript (timed words for the whole video, or for the clip alone with transcript_from set to the clip's start) and a style; without a transcript it only cuts.

3. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run and tool tool:cut-and-caption. The door runs it in a container and answers {"result": {...}}; an error comes back as {"error": "what to change"}.
4. Read result.duration_seconds, result.captions and files.video, the clip in your files.

worked_examples.title: A 2.5 second clip with one caption line
worked_examples.ask: Cut 3.5 to 6 seconds of my video and caption it.
worked_examples.given: read from tools/media-composition/do-work/cut-and-caption.mjs and run on a 7 second clip with the transcript of the whole video: only "Fresh bread daily." (4.2 to 5.6 s) falls inside 3.5 to 6, so one caption line is made

worked_examples.title: No transcript: it only cuts
worked_examples.ask: Just cut 1 to 3 seconds out of my video.
worked_examples.given: read from tools/media-composition/do-work/cut-and-caption.mjs: with no transcript there are no lines, so captions is 0 and no subtitles are burned in
